parameters.excerpt: For each bit in 61:58, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.reasoning: Which privilege mode inhibit bits (MINH, SINH, UINH, VSINH, VUINH) in mcyclecfg/minstretcfg are writable depends on which privilege modes are implemented. Unimplemented modes have read-only-zero bits. This is a NORM_CSR_RW parameter controlling which bits of the register are functional.
